title: Foundly
tagline: A platform to help you find your lost items and return found items to their rightful owners.
description:
Leverages attestations and blockchain technology to help users report lost or found items and facilitate their return to the rightful owners.
Community-driven solution that facilitates the recovery of lost items in a secure and transparent manner and improve the overall user experience
how_its_made:
Use the AttestationStation to securely store and verify attestations associated with lost and found items
Integrate ApeCoin as a native token, allowing users to pay for services or reward those who help locate and return lost items
Use Polybase as decentralized storage solution for storing and managing user data, attestation documents, and item metadata
Implement Push Protocol to enable cross-chain notifications and messaging
